purpose: Template for a reproducible development or approval-bound survival-training extract. This file is not a dataset, a clinical approval, or a production configuration.

population.target_description: Adults eligible for the selected continuous-NHANES examination and mortality-linkage files; confirm cycle-specific eligibility from each codebook.
population.analysis_unit: one NHANES participant identified by SEQN
population.age_rule: Record the source-coded age rule used for the analysis. Do not assume that BIA eligibility is identical across cycles.

linkage.duration_semantics: Use the MEC follow-up field because BIA is collected in the mobile examination center; document the choice in the analysis record.
linkage.disclosure_control_review: Required: public-use follow-up or cause-of-death values may be perturbed; document whether the selected endpoint remains appropriate.

inclusion_rules: Link to an eligible mortality record (ELIGSTAT=1).
Retain censored observations with valid positive follow-up.
Apply the cycle-reviewed BIA examination-status and fit-quality rules recorded below.
exclusion_rules: Duplicate SEQN or failed source-key integrity check.
Invalid or non-positive duration, non-binary event, or non-finite measured value.
Rows excluded by the approved cycle-specific examination, pregnancy, device, or quality protocol.
eligibility.optional_feature_policy: Keep optional missing values as native NaN for XGBoost; do not impute or select complete cases silently.
eligibility.inference_boundary: This training anchor contract does not weaken the assessment MVV enforced by the API.

measurement_and_derivation.column_map_policy: Provide an explicit NHANESColumnMap per cycle and keep the reviewed map with the frozen manifest.
measurement_and_derivation.missing_value_policy: List every cycle-specific sentinel and recoding decision here before mapping; unlisted codes must fail review rather than be guessed.
measurement_and_derivation.unit_audit: Record source units, canonical units, conversion formula, reviewer, and evidence for every mapped measurement.
derived_fields: phase_angle from mapped 50-kHz resistance/reactance when available
ecw_tbw from mapped extracellular fluid and total body water
ffmi from mapped fat-free mass and height
fib_4 from age, AST, ALT, and platelets

bia_quality.source_note: The CDC BIX codebook describes fit-quality categories; the accepted set is an analysis decision, not silently assumed by this template.

survey_design.weight_selection_rule: Select and record the cycle-appropriate MEC/BIA analytic weight from the NHANES analytic guidelines; do not copy a weight name across cycles without review.
survey_design.adapter_weight_semantics: Only when weight_kind=case_weight and standardized sample_weight values are supplied for every row, the current adapter passes positive weights as XGBoost DMatrix case weights and uses them for its profile-likelihood mapper calibration; replicate and stratum declarations are metadata only.
survey_design.variance_plan: Record the survey strata, PSU, variance estimator, replicate/jackknife method, and software used for any inferential or population estimate.

training_recipe.mapper_policy: Record whether Gompertz parameters were supplied or fitted in-sample; the artifact persists the resulting mapper and provenance.

required_sensitivity_runs: native missing-value handling versus a prespecified complete-case analysis

approval.note: A populated manifest is still not clinical approval; E-005 requires external validation, cutoff review, uncertainty review, reference-panel approval, and human sign-off.
